tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a free group-scheduling event (a when2meet/Doodle alternative) and get a shareable link. Use this when a human asks you to find a time for a group to meet. Returns a public event_url anyone can open with no login to paint when they're free. Then call get_results to see the time slot the most

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Read the current responses for an Overlap event and get the best meeting times (the slots where the most people are free). Pass the event id (the code after /e/ in the event_url).
